craft_notes: Sthāyin: ripening-joy (triple cause). Sanskrit first: three ablatives → L4 keeps all three uncut line 1, fruit line 2. Rows: row 2 (causes whole line 1). Rupture: colon after joy — causes done, mass stated. Close: end-weight on mass (density). Minimal pass: 'dense' added? L4 says 'one dense mass' vs L3 'one dense mass' — same. colon for L3 dash. Read aloud: three causes climb, mass lands. Rejected: 'solidifies' — killed: grows kept (organic); 'awareness' for bodha — killed: waking kept (axis).

lines: Mark your notions, hold pure knowing, win the highest joy:
the sage grows one dense mass of waking.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svasaṃkalpaparāmarśād viśuddhajñānasaṃśrayāt / paramāhlādalābhāc ca bodhaikaghanatā muneḥ

reads_against.argmap: One-mass awakening comes from grasping concepts, resorting to pure knowing, and gaining supreme joy.
c1_essence: Concept-grasping, pure knowing, supreme joy: one-mass awakening.
